Definition: a Kenite or member of the tribe of Kajin
BiblicalUsage: The Kenites are a desert people woven through Israel's story: the scribes at Jabez are counted among them, and Saul warns them to depart from the Amalekites because they showed kindness to Israel coming up out of Egypt. Jethro and Heber and Jael all stand in that line.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Kenites show that kindness to God's people is remembered, because Saul spared them for what they did in the exodus.
